title: Its Your Fault
description: Your Game, Your Rule, Your Nightmare
body:
This mod is only a multiplayer plugin, this cant be played on singleplayer as it is a Paper/Spigot plugin.
A multiplayer-only horror plugin that manipulates players, fakes crashes, corrupts chat, and makes the world feel wrong. No jumpscares. No mercy. Everything is your fault.
This is not a game mechanic.
This is not a prank plugin.
This is psychological horror.



ITS YOUR FAULT is a multiplayer-only horror plugin designed to make players feel watched, guilty, and unsafe — even when nothing is happening.

The plugin does not announce itself.
There are no commands, no menus, and no warnings.

Things simply begin to go wrong.



Fake crashes and disconnect screens
Corrupted and glitched chat messages
Whispering system messages that blame the player
Random “world instability” events
One player targeted at a time (others see nothing)
Forbidden words that instantly stop everything
Unexplained pauses, freezes, and silence
Slowly escalating paranoia
Zero jumpscares — fear comes from uncertainty



The server looks broken.
The player thinks it’s their fault.
Everyone else thinks they’re lying.



This plugin is INTENTIONAL HORROR
Designed to feel like something is wrong

Not recommended for:

Young players

Anxious players

Public servers

Best experienced blind, with friends



Runs silently in the background

Uses vanilla-style messages and sounds

Mimics real Minecraft errors and corruption

Never explains itself

Never tells players what triggered it

Server plugin ONLY

Paper / Spigot

Minecraft 1.21.6

Multiplayer required



Stop your server

Upload the .jar to /plugins

Start the server

Do nothing else

AND PRAY FOR THE BEST.



This plugin does not damage worlds, corrupt saves, or break servers.
All effects are simulated.



Nothing is safe.
Nothing is explained.
ITS YOUR FAULT.



































HES HERE NOONE CAN SAVE YOU. HES IS EVERYTHING.
